targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
    ${item_formatted_for_display} as item,
    ${item_formatted_for_filter} as filter_item, 
    cnt_all as count,
    countMergeIf(
        `count()`,
        statusCode >= '400'
        AND statusCode < '600'
    ) as errorcount,
    errorcount / cnt_all AS error_ratio
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY item, filter_item
HAVING error_ratio >= ${minErrorRate}
ORDER BY count DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Treemap by HTTP Error Rate; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    (SUM(cache_hit) / (SUM(cache_hit) + SUM(cache_miss))) AS total,
    hdx_cdn
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        countMergeIf(`count()`,cacheStatus = 1) AS cache_hit,
        countMergeIf(`count()`,cacheStatus = 0) AS cache_miss,
        hdx_cdn
    FROM 
        ${table}
    WHERE 
        $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        GROUP BY 
            hdx_cdn
)
GROUP BY 
    hdx_cdn
ORDER BY hdx_cdn
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Edge Cache Hit Total %; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    response_total_bytes*8/${seconds} AS theBytes,
    reqTimeSec as time,
    hdx_cdn
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY 
    reqTimeSec, hdx_cdn
ORDER BY hdx_cdn
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Peak Throughput Rate; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  reqTimeSec,
  response_total_bytes*8/${seconds} AS TotalThroughput
FROM
  ${table}
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY reqTimeSec
ORDER BY reqTimeSec

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total Throughput; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    reqTimeSec as time,
    response_total_bytes*8/${seconds} AS Throughput,
    hdx_cdn as CDN
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, CDN
ORDER BY time, CDN
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Throughput by CDN; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    reqTimeSec as time,
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '400' AND statusCode < '500') AS "4xx", 
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '500' AND statusCode < '600') AS "5xx",
    hdx_cdn
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, hdx_cdn
ORDER BY time, hdx_cdn

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=4xx-5xx Response Status Count; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    reqTimeSec as time,
    hdx_cdn as CDN,
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '200'AND statusCode < '300') AS Total
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY 
    time, CDN
ORDER BY 
    time, CDN
    
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=2xx Response Status Count; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    hdx_cdn,
    response_total_bytes as total_bytes,
    round(response_total_bytes * 100.0 / sum(response_total_bytes) OVER(), 2) as percentage
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY hdx_cdn
ORDER BY percentage DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Traffic percentage (bytes) per CDN; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    user_agent_category,
    response_total_bytes as total_bytes,
    round(response_total_bytes * 100.0 / sum(response_total_bytes) OVER(), 2) as percentage
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY user_agent_category
ORDER BY percentage DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Traffic Percentage (bytes) per User Agent Category; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    reqTimeSec as time,
    hdx_cdn as CDN,
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode > '399' AND statusCode < '500') AS Total
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY 
    time, CDN
ORDER BY 
    time, CDN

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=4xx Response Status Count; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    reqTimeSec as time,
    hdx_cdn as CDN,
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode > '499' AND statusCode < '600') AS Total
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY 
    time, CDN
ORDER BY 
    time, CDN

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=5xx Response Status Count; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    reqTimeSec AS time,
    quantiles_response_ttfb_ms[2] AS TTFB,
    hdx_cdn AS CDN
FROM
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY
    time, hdx_cdn
ORDER BY
    time asc, hdx_cdn

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Median TTFB by CDN; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    reqHost AS Host,
    country AS Country,
    SUM(Total) AS Total
FROM (
    SELECT 
        reqHost,
        country,
        cnt_all AS Total,
        hdx_cdn as CDN
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
      AND notEmpty(reqHost)
      AND $__adHocFilter()
    GROUP BY hdx_cdn, reqHost, country
)
GROUP BY Host, Country
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 100

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Global Requests by Country - All CDNs; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top 100 Hosts by Country - All CDNs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    Edge_GeoInfo AS POP,
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '200'AND statusCode < '300') AS "2xx",
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '300'AND statusCode < '400') AS "3xx",
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '400'AND statusCode < '500') AS "4xx",
    countMergeIf(`count()`,statusCode >= '500'AND statusCode < '600') AS "5xx",
    cnt_all AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY 
    Edge_GeoInfo
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 100

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Edge Pop by 2xx-5xx - All CDNs; du=${__user.login}'

list.definition:
WITH
    '${filter:raw}' AS flt,
    ${drill_chain} as drill_chain,
    arrayFilter(dim -> '${treeMapGroupBy}' != dim, drill_chain) as filtered,
    arrayConcat(['${treeMapGroupBy}'], filtered) as reordered,
    arrayFilter(dim -> position(flt, dim) = 0, reordered) AS remaining
SELECT 
if(
    (if(empty(remaining), '${treeMapGroupBy}', remaining[1])) = 'statusCode', 'toString(statusCode)',
    (if(empty(remaining), '${treeMapGroupBy}', remaining[1]))
  ) AS result
list.name: next_dim
list.query:
WITH
    '${filter:raw}' AS flt,
    ${drill_chain} as drill_chain,
    arrayFilter(dim -> '${treeMapGroupBy}' != dim, drill_chain) as filtered,
    arrayConcat(['${treeMapGroupBy}'], filtered) as reordered,
    arrayFilter(dim -> position(flt, dim) = 0, reordered) AS remaining
SELECT 
if(
    (if(empty(remaining), '${treeMapGroupBy}', remaining[1])) = 'statusCode', 'toString(statusCode)',
    (if(empty(remaining), '${treeMapGroupBy}', remaining[1]))
  ) AS result
